summary: Complete 5-stage B2B Headhunt Lead Generation Pipeline for TD Consulting. Stages: (1) Company Discovery via Google Places API, (2) Company Research via Google Custom Search + web scraping, (3) Job Analysis via Google CSE targeting career pages and VN job boards, (4) HR Leads Identification via LinkedIn search + SalesQL enrichment, (5) Outreach Strategy with prioritized contact plan. Reuses existing API keys (Google CSE, SalesQL, Google Places) and patterns from email_discovery_bot.py. Architecture uses modular Python classes with async pipeline, Excel/CSV output with scoring system. Total 9 new files in e:\TDC_App\TD_Consulting_App\Client_Search\.
